name: Chapters, Bookmarks and A-B Loop
author: Vestra Player
punchline: Jump by chapter and bookmark; loop an A-B range
description:
Lists the media's chapters; adds, names and manages bookmarks for each file; jumps between chapters and bookmarks and shows them as marks on the seek bar; sets an A-B range and loops it a chosen number of times.
Find it in the context menu under "Playback ▸ Chapters and Bookmarks" and "Playback ▸ A-B Loop".
